units.source_text: 他决定在设想计划后的第四天行动……

en.t: He decided to act on the fourth day after conceiving the plan...

units.source_text: 他选择了星期六的夜里，这一天会送配给的洗澡用水来。

en.t: He chose Saturday night, the day when the rationed bath water would be delivered.

units.source_text: 在那天的前一夜，他先装作感冒，呼呼大睡一觉。

en.t: On the night before, he first pretended to have a cold and slept soundly.

units.source_text: 为了不让对方看出破绽，他硬是叫女人给他找来阿司匹林。

en.t: To keep her from noticing anything suspicious, he insisted that the woman find him some aspirin.

units.source_text: 在杂货店的深处，她找出些陈货。

en.t: From the back of the general store, she found some old stock.
The tablets had completely changed color.

units.source_text: 他就着烧酒服了两片，立刻就有明显的效果。

en.t: He took two tablets with shochu, and they had an obvious effect at once.

units.source_text: 女人干完活回来之前，除了听到一次搬运大网篮的声音以外，几乎没有其他什么记忆。

en.t: Until the woman came back from finishing her work, he remembered almost nothing except once hearing the sound of a large carrying basket being moved.
